test(daemon): a lane declaration that throws fails the payload helper with its stack (candybar-skeleton-wj0c.88o)

The helper dropped declareLanes' faults, so a broken owner fixture read as
an unexplained failed cell; it closes the home and throws them instead, as
the daemon logs them as errors. requestPayload's header says its home lives
for one request.

test(daemon): a home closes through the case's cleanups, and each test's one close path is its afterEach (candybar-skeleton-wj0c.88o)

declaredLanes takes the cleanups array the other rig helpers take, so a
caller cannot open a home without handing over its close. The git cache
cases drop the trailing closes their afterEach now repeats; the closes a
case asserts across, or orders before a repo's removal, stay.

test(daemon): a test closes every home it opens, so no file's periods tick inside a later file's close case (candybar-skeleton-wj0c.88o)

The daemon close case's leftover timers were never its daemon's. The
payload-owners helpers held a real host source through a home nobody
closed, and the git cache tests left their providers open, so their
periods re-armed for the life of the Jest worker. Held together, they
re-arm together, so the close case failed only when that turn fell inside
it. An audit of armed periods at each file's end now reads zero in every
worker-tier file.

chore(release): set `package.json` to 1.214.0
